steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary containing the vendor's bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer visibility configuration.
Allow buyer bid editing as required by the case configuration.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case configuration.
Open the RFQ stage before accessing its Responses tab.
Open the RFQ Responses screen where the Settings menu is available.
Choose Order Activity from the RFQ Settings menu and leave its drawer open.
Assert that the Activity window or drawer opened.
